parties: B.A.G Films and Media Limited; Anuradha Prasad Shukla
headline: B.A.G Films and Media Limited: Substantial Acquisition Disclosure under SEBI Takeover Regulations
sum: Anuradha Prasad Shukla has submitted a Regulation 31(4) disclosure to NSE regarding substantial acquisition of shares in B.A.G Films and Media Limited. The filing triggers mandatory takeover code compliance under SEBI's 2011 Regulations.
implication: A Reg 31(4) disclosure indicates the acquirer has crossed a material shareholding threshold (typically 25% or entry into concert with existing promoter); this flags a potential open offer obligation or exemption application under the SEBI Takeover Code.
detail: Anuradha Prasad Shukla has submitted disclosure documentation to the NSE under Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011. This regulation requires disclosure of acquisition of substantial shares or voting rights that trigger takeover code provisions. The specific shareholding quantum, acquisition timeline, and consideration are not disclosed in the headline filing. The disclosure is a mandatory gate under SEBI's takeover framework; acquirers crossing 25% shareholding or entering concert arrangements must either trigger an open offer or seek exemption.
